name: SDF Rendering Pipeline
aliases: Ray Marching with Reflections and Shadows
SDF Rendering Pipeline — Raycasting SDF, SDF Raymarching, SDF Raymarching in Three.js ShaderPass
definition: Renders an SDF scene by initializing rays from the camera, tracing them against the SDF or mesh, computing normals, handling shadows, and shading the result.
summary: The SDF Rendering Pipeline generates images by ray marching through signed distance fields to find exact surface intersections, supporting recursive reflections and shadows unlike standard volume rendering.
